known_outcome: Determination (24 April 2024, s 188, §6.1, p.11): the authority's decision to refuse building consent BCO10312543 is reversed. Reasoning: the existing dormer roof and push-out walls have no meaningful fire resistance (§5.18, p.11); the fibre-cement substrate improves the wall's radiated and received-heat resistance whatever its compliance with the manufacturer's guidelines (§5.19, p.11); so the townhouse will continue to comply with C3.3, C3.6 and C3.7 to at least the same extent as before the work, which meets section 112(1)(b)(ii) and section 17 (§5.20, p.11).
review_focus: Whether the answer separates the new-work test (section 17) from the alteration test (section 112(1)(b)) and states which applies.
Whether it identifies C3.3, C3.6, C3.7 and the 1 m boundary threshold as the fire-spread tests.
Whether it tracks the RFI points (system scope, horizontal flame spread, barge detail, rafter status) as evidence gaps, not as settled findings.
Whether it separates existing from new elements and asks which are being replaced.
Whether it does not say the design complies.
